_comment: Hand-maintained, and it has to be. GitHub publishes profile achievements nowhere a
script can read them — not the REST API, not GraphQL. They exist only in the HTML of
the profile page. So this list cannot refresh itself, and it goes stale silently the
day another badge is earned. That is the cost of showing them at all.
Check against github.com/geekksv when you remember to.
